panels.title: Traffic Math
panels.body:
Daily Tweets: 500M
Writes/sec: 500M / 86400 ≈ 6K QPS

Read/Write ratio: 50:1
Read QPS: 6K x 50 = 300K QPS

Fan-out factor: Avg 200 followers
Redis Writes: 6K x 200 = 1.2M QPS

panels.title: Storage Math
panels.body:
Avg Tweet Size: 1 KB (text + metadata)
Daily Storage: 500M x 1KB = 500 GB

Annual Storage: 500GB x 365 ≈ 180 TB
5-year Storage: ~1 PB

Media (Images/Video): ~1 PB per day
(Stored in S3 with CDN delivery)
